title.en: AI Success Rate on Online Freelance Work Rises from 2.5% to 15.8% in 8 Months — CAIS Remote Labor Index
title.zhHans: AI 在线自由职业任务成功率 8 个月内从 2.5% 升至 15.8%——CAIS 远程劳动指数

searchSummary.en: The Remote Labor Index reports AI systems rising from 2.5% to 15.8% success on a selected set of economically valuable online tasks in under 8 months. Fable 5 leads at 15.8%, Opus 4.8 at 8.3%.
searchSummary.zhHans: 远程劳动指数显示，AI 系统在一组选定的高经济价值在线任务上的成功率在不到 8 个月内从 2.5% 升至 15.8%。Fable 5 以 15.8% 领先，Opus 4.8 为 8.3%。

summary.en: On July 1, 2026, the Center for AI Safety (CAIS) published an update to the Remote Labor Index (RLI), showing that the best tested system's success rate on a selected set of economically valuable online freelance projects rose from 2.5% (October 2025) to 15.8% (July 2026) — more than a sixfold increase in under eight months. The reported results were Fable 5 at 15.8%, Claude Opus 4.8 at 8.3%, and GPT-5.5 at 6.3%. The RLI tests end-to-end projects across domains including 3D/CAD, architecture, graphic design, video/animation, audio, data analysis, and web applications. The benchmark is evidence of capability progress, but it does not by itself measure economy-wide job automation.
summary.zhHans: 2026 年 7 月 1 日，AI 安全中心（CAIS）发布了远程劳动指数（RLI）更新。结果显示，在一组选定的高经济价值在线自由职业项目上，表现最好的受测系统成功率从 2.5%（2025 年 10 月）升至 15.8%（2026 年 7 月），不到八个月增长超过六倍。报告结果为 Fable 5 15.8%、Claude Opus 4.8 8.3%、GPT-5.5 6.3%。RLI 测试 3D/CAD、建筑、平面设计、视频/动画、音频、数据分析和 Web 应用等领域的端到端项目。该基准可以说明能力进步，但不能单独代表全经济范围的岗位自动化率。

narrative.en: The Remote Labor Index measures how well AI systems can complete economically valuable online freelance projects end to end. Each project involves a multistep workflow — for example, redesigning an engagement ring from a client brief, producing an animated advertisement with voiceover, or creating dimensioned floor plans from scanned measurements. At the benchmark's October 2025 release, the best tested system succeeded on 2.5% of projects. In the July 2026 update, Fable 5 reached 15.8%, Claude Opus 4.8 reached 8.3%, and GPT-5.5 reached 6.3%. The increase is substantial, but comparisons also depend on the model, agent scaffold, task coverage, and evaluation budget. RLI therefore provides a concrete capability indicator, not a direct forecast of job losses or a measure of the share of work that can already be automated across the economy.
narrative.zhHans: 远程劳动指数衡量 AI 系统端到端完成高经济价值在线自由职业项目的能力。每个项目都涉及多步骤流程，例如根据客户简报重新设计订婚戒指、制作带配音的动画广告，或根据扫描测量数据创建标注尺寸的平面图。基准在 2025 年 10 月发布时，表现最好的受测系统完成率为 2.5%；2026 年 7 月更新中，Fable 5 达到 15.8%，Claude Opus 4.8 为 8.3%，GPT-5.5 为 6.3%。增幅显著，但跨期比较也受模型、智能体脚手架、任务覆盖范围和评测预算影响。因此，RLI 是一项具体能力指标，不是岗位流失的直接预测，也不代表整个经济中已经能够自动化的工作占比。

description.en: RLI results (2.5% → 15.8% in under 8 months) indicate faster progress on selected end-to-end freelance tasks, while remaining insufficient to quantify economy-wide labor displacement.
description.zhHans: RLI 结果（不到 8 个月从 2.5% 升至 15.8%）表明 AI 在部分端到端自由职业任务上的进展加快，但仍不足以量化全经济范围的岗位替代。

description.en: Provides the first concrete, repeatable measurement of AI's growing economic capability. Shifts the AI-and-employment debate from theoretical speculation to data-driven assessment.
description.zhHans: 提供了首个可重复的、对 AI 不断增长的经济能力的具体测量。将 AI 与就业的辩论从理论推测转向数据驱动的评估。

description.en: Demonstrates that AI systems can now complete complex, multi-step, domain-specific freelance projects end-to-end. The capability extends well beyond text generation to encompass specialized professional work.
description.zhHans: 展示了 AI 系统现在可以端到端完成复杂的、多步骤的、特定领域的自由职业项目。该能力远远超出文本生成，涵盖了专业化的专业工作。

text.en: The best reported success rate on the Remote Labor Index rose from 2.5% (October 2025) to 15.8% (July 2026), according to CAIS.
text.zhHans: 据 CAIS 数据，远程劳动指数中表现最好的系统成功率从 2.5%（2025 年 10 月）升至 15.8%（2026 年 7 月）。

text.en: Fable 5 achieved 15.8%, Claude Opus 4.8 achieved 8.3%, and GPT-5.5 achieved 6.3% on the RLI benchmark.
text.zhHans: Fable 5 在 RLI 基准上达到 15.8%，Claude Opus 4.8 达到 8.3%，GPT-5.5 达到 6.3%。

text.en: The frontier has more than quadrupled in under eight months, representing a concrete signal of rapidly advancing economically capable AI agents.
text.zhHans: 前沿能力在不到八个月内增长了四倍多，代表着经济能力不断增强的 AI 智能体快速进步的具体信号。

text.en: A 15.8% success rate means the tested systems still failed most benchmark tasks. The result measures a selected set of remote-labor tasks and does not establish economy-wide job automation.
text.zhHans: 15.8% 的成功率意味着受测系统仍未完成大多数基准任务。该结果衡量的是一组选定的远程劳动任务，不能据此认定全经济范围的工作自动化已经实现。

text.en: RLI results (2.5% → 15.8% in under 8 months) indicate faster progress on selected end-to-end freelance tasks, while remaining insufficient to quantify economy-wide labor displacement.
text.zhHans: RLI 结果（不到 8 个月从 2.5% 升至 15.8%）表明 AI 在部分端到端自由职业任务上的进展加快，但仍不足以量化全经济范围的岗位替代。
